text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in opening paragraph","quality":"clear claim","description":"The essay states a definite position early and makes the writer's stance on driverless cars unmistakable."},{"evidence":"multiple body paragraphs with topic focus","quality":"organizational structure","description":"The essay develops its argument in separate, coherent sections instead of presenting ideas as one scattered response."},{"evidence":"uses article details about Google, sensors, fuel use, and liability","quality":"textual support","description":"The essay grounds its claims in specific information from the source article rather than relying mostly on unsupported opinion."},{"evidence":"explains benefits then addresses flaws and regulations","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"The essay acknowledges opposing concerns and responds to them instead of ignoring the negative side."},{"evidence":"reasoned links like 'as technology improves' and 'rules and regulations can adapt'","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"The essay does more than list facts by explaining how the evidence supports the writer's conclusion."},{"evidence":"conclusion restates position and sums up main reasons","quality":"conclusion development","description":"The ending wraps up the argument by reinforcing the thesis and synthesizing the main points."}]}
